QuestInfo.name: Moonlight Sonata's Whereabouts
QuestInfo.0: Meanwhile, on the moon, Grandpa Moon Bunny has a request for you.
QuestInfo.1: Grandpa Moon Bunny tells you about the forgotten song #bMoonlight Sonata#k. Grandpa Moon Bunny tells you that he wants to play Moonlight Sonata to Baby Moon Bunny before he dies. He asks you to find the Moonlight Sonata Sheet Music for him.\nFirst things first. Go ask #bCassandra#k if she knows anything.
QuestInfo.2: Grandpa Moon Bunny told you that he wants to play the lost #bMoonlight Sonata#k to Baby Moon Bunny before he dies.  He asked you to find the Moonlight Sonata Sheet Music for him.\nYou went to #bCassandra#k to hear what she had to say.
QuestInfo.rewardSummary:
EXP 500
Can proceed to the 'Fairy Knowledge' quest

0.0: Welcome. I've been waiting for you, #b#h0##k. I called you because I have a favor to ask. Please listen to my story.\r\n
0.1: Since long ago, a piece called the Moonlight Sonata has been passed through the generations here on the moon. This song brought peace to those who heard it and cleansed their soul. When I was young, I would sit on my grandfather's lap and listen it.
0.2: But one day, the sheet music to the piece disappeared. It's been slowly forgotten, and now there are no Moon Bunnies left who know the piece. I don't want it to disappear like this. I want to sing it to my grandson, Baby Moon Bunny, just like my grandfather sang it for me.
0.3: As you can see, I don't have much longer here on the moon. I heard that you travel all over Maple World. Perhaps you can learn about the #bMoonlight Sonata#k in your travels. For the sake of my Baby Moon Bunny, please find the sheet music to the #bMoonlight Sonata#k.

yes.0: I've heard there's a great information broker named #bCassandra#k on Maple World. Maybe you can ask her?

no.0: Will the Moonlight Sonata be forgotten just like this...? #n#b(Grandpa Moon Bunny's eyes glisten with tears.)#k

1.0: What brings you here? I'm busy so just get to the point, got it? \r\n#L0##bDo You know anything about the Moonlight Sonata?#l\n#k
1.1: Moonlight Sonata? That famous Moon Bunny song? No, not really. I hear it disappeared long ago... Why are you looking for it now? \r\n#L0##bGrandpa Moon Bunny wants to find it.#l\n#k
1.2: Grandpa Moon Bunny? After all this time... He should've taken better care of it in the first place.
